fusions.name: Wrung Out
fusions.desc: A thousand clinging feet close on an enemy at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Passed Along
fusions.desc: Sends a locust into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage, then on to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage. Holds up to 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Held Fast
fusions.desc: Holds every enemy within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. For 8 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds. Held enemies move 30% slower for 3 seconds after they are let go.

fusions.name: Work Shared Out
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
